Author: colliexiv
Name: JP/EN Chat
Description:
Shows chat in a two-pane window with the original Japanese on the left and a streamed English translation on the right, aligned row by row.
Type English into the input box to get a Japanese translation with a word-by-word breakdown and back-translation, confirm, and send.
Translation uses your own OpenRouter API key (chat lines in the channels you enable are sent to OpenRouter). Early release.
Punchline: Two-pane JP/EN chat translation for English players on Japanese data centers.
